name: cg_coin_categories_market
description:
Coin categories with market data from CoinGecko (coins/categories), sorted by market cap.
Returns {categories: [{id, name, market_cap, market_cap_change_24h (percent), volume_24h, top_3_coins (image URLs), content, updated_at}, ...]}.
Inputs: none.
For names and ids only use cg_coin_categories_list; for the whole market cg_market_global.
Example: {}
